(Search snippet content — GCC Secretary-General statement; primary GCC text relayed via non-approved aggregators. UNCONFIRMED by approved outlets.)

GCC Secretary-General said Iranian targeting of infrastructure and civilian facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan "constitutes war crimes requiring immediate international accountability", describing it as "a highly dangerous escalation, a grave violation of international law and the United Nations (UN) Charter".
Related GCC statements condemned Iranian attacks on the Saudi tanker "Wadiyan" and Qatari tanker "Al Rekayyat" in the Strait of Hormuz, citing UN Security Council Resolution 2817.
Dating ambiguous between 18 and 19 July 2026.
